title: U-type Seals with Asymmetrical and Symmetrical Lips Used for Fluid Power Application
clause_1_scope: This Indian Standard covers the dimensions, material and other requirements of U-type seals with asymmetrical lips and symmetrical lips used in fluid power systems.
clause_3_terminology: type Seals with Asymmetrical and Symmetrical Lips Used for Fluid Power Application
